record.label: Literal Phase-1 Kerdock adaptation audit
record.summary: The literal audit corrects the earlier method account: Phase 1 used a complete real-Kerdock MUB rule plus exact low-layer moment snaps, while #327723 used a nonlinear empirical-gate CV. Both were reconstructed for Phase 2. Every target-blind rank-0 form fails: Hermite D12 endpoint error is 7.9612e-8, the best degreewise snapped construction is 7.7496e-8 with wrong-signed truth correlation, and the empirical-gate replay remains far outside the endpoint gate.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed on observer-fit rank0 for the Phase-1-faithful sampled-state family; reopen only for a distinct exact-mean statistic, not another snap or shrink.
